changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.AUDIT_LOG ( AUDIT_ID NUMBER(19) GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, EVENT_TIME TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL, EVENT_TYPE VARCHAR2(32 CHAR) NOT NULL, ACTOR VARCHAR2(64 CHAR) NOT NULL, ENTITY_TYPE VARCHAR2(32 CHAR) NOT NULL, ENTITY_ID VARCHAR2(64 CHAR) NOT NULL, DETAILS_JSON CLOB CONSTRAINT CK_AUDIT_JSON CHECK (DETAILS_JSON IS JSON), CONSTRAINT PK_AUDIT PRIMARY KEY (AUDIT_ID) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (EVENT_TIME) INTERVAL (NUMTODSINTERVAL(30, 'DAY')) (PARTITION P_INITIAL VALUES LESS THAN (TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'));
